text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INC-2026-2347 opened for tenant=kestrel-fin in us-west1. Symptoms: elevated token latency and 502s from dedicated pool kestrel-dpool-03. Autoscale attempting to add nodes but provisioning delayed.

pagerduty-bot: Paging taylor_sre (primary) on-call. Priority: P1. Escalation timer: 5m.

taylor_sre: on it. I'm looking at pool health + autoscaler logs. tagging @alex_cheng for runtime help.

alex_cheng: I can help. seeing repeated OOM+retry in inference runtime logs for shards on g4dn-16. KV cache pressure spikes. Exporting logs now.

maria_ops: @taylor_sre heads-up from account: Kestrel Financial is in the middle of batch ingest now, they have high concurrent traffic. They asked for mitigation asap. Elaine is on customer comms.

simon_runtime: Possible regression from yesterday's kernel selector patch? Rolling back to previous kernel candidate on affected nodes might be fastest.

taylor_sre: Agreed. Two parallel mitigation tracks: 1) warm up and shift traffic to us-east1 dedicated pool (kestrel-dpool-01-east) 2) rollback runtime kernel on affected nodes in us-west1 to reduce evictions. We'll start with traffic shift to avoid customer-visible errors.

jessica_support: Can we confirm current DNS TTL for tenant edge is 60s? Need to know how fast cutover will propagate.

alex_cheng: TTL is 60. We maintain a per-tenant CNAME: kestrel.api.redwood.io -> router-us-west1.redwood.net. Traffic router supports route-weight adjustments.

maria_ops: ETA from Kestrel: they can tolerate up to ~2 minutes of degraded responses but want clear status updates every 10 minutes.

elaine_account: I'll draft the customer message. For now: "We're routing traffic to alternate region to reduce latency and errors. No data loss expected." Will send when we have a plan and ETA.

pagerduty-bot: Handoff reminder: taylor_sre is primary until 1200 UTC, alex_cheng will be secondary.

--- 5 min later ---

taylor_sre: Preparing staged traffic shift. Steps: 
1) ensure warm nodes in us-east are at min capacity (scale to 3 nodes)
2) update route weights: west=90 -> west=30, east=70 canary
3) monitor error rate and latency for 10m
4) if stable, continue to full cutover and then adjust DNS CNAME TTL to lower value if needed

simon_runtime: I'm bringing up warm nodes now: running deploy script to provision nodes in kestrel-dpool-01-east. Command: 
```
./infra/provision_node.sh --pool kestrel-dpool-01-east --count 3 --profile warm
```

alex_cheng: I also pushed a temporary KV cache size bump for east pool to avoid misses: config change applied.

jessica_support: Noted. Updating internal incident timeline.

--- 12 min later ---

simon_runtime: Warm nodes are ready and registered with router. Health checks green.

alex_cheng: Starting weight shift: updating traffic router. Command: 
```
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/v1/weights \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"kestrel-fin","weights":{"us-west1":30,"us-east1":70}}'
```

pagerduty-bot: Action logged by alex_cheng.

--- 2 min later ---

taylor_sre: Observing immediate drop in 502s from 7.2% -> 2.4%. Token latency median improved from 210ms -> 150ms. Errors trending down.

maria_ops: Kestrel has acknowledged reduced errors on their side. Asking for ETA to full cutover.

alex_cheng: If trends continue for 10m, we'll move to 100% east. Will wait for 10m stable window.

elaine_account: Sending customer note now (first update): 
"We have routed the majority of traffic to an alternate region to mitigate errors. Engineering is monitoring. Next update in 10 minutes or sooner if situation changes."

raj_sales: Please cc customer success lead on the message and flag any SLA exposure.

--- 10 min later ---

taylor_sre: 10m stable window met. Errors at 0.6%, median latency 140ms. Proceeding to ramp to 100% east.

alex_cheng: Changing weights to west=0 east=100. Command executed.

pagerduty-bot: Action logged by alex_cheng.

--- 3 min later ---

taylor_sre: Cutover complete. DNS still points at router-us-west1.redwood.net with CNAME. We will perform DNS CNAME swap for redundancy: change kestrel.api.redwood.io -> router-us-east1.redwood.net. TTL 60 will allow fast swap; performing now.

simon_runtime: DNS change submitted to Route53. Record update id: Z3XXXX.

jessica_support: Noting DNS propagation. Some clients with cached entries may still hit west for up to TTL.

maria_ops: Confirmed Kestrel sees stabilized traffic and no customer errors reported in last 5m.

elaine_account: Sent second customer update: "Traffic has been fully routed to alternate region. We will continue to monitor and plan a rollback if any regression observed. No action needed from your side."

raj_sales: I'll follow up with account ops to negotiate any SLA credits if necessary.

--- rollback track update ---

alex_cheng: Meanwhile, I'm performing a controlled rollback of yesterday's kernel selector on the affected us-west nodes to eliminate root cause risk. Command run: 
```
/infra/deploy_rollback.sh --nodes tag:us-west1:kestrel-dpool-03 --pkg kernel-selector:v1.2.8
```

simon_runtime: Rollback complete on 4 of 6 nodes, remaining 2 rebooting. Observed fewer OOMs after rollback on those nodes.

--- communication / handoff ---

taylor_sre: Primary handoff planned in 45 minutes. @alex_cheng will be primary after that. Leaving notes: traffic is in us-east, DNS cname updated, rollback in progress. If errors spike >1% for 5m, revert weights to previous stable set and contact pager duty.

elaine_account: I'll stay on the customer thread for the next hour and sync with support.

jessica_support: Preparing status page update draft to post: "Kestrel tenant experienced degraded performance in us-west1. Traffic has been shifted to us-east1 and service restored. We are investigating root cause and will provide a post-incident report."

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: Please add incident severity, timeline, and customer impact in the postmortem ticket INC-2026-2347-PM.

--- 30 minutes later ---

taylor_sre: Confirming incident stable. Rolling incident to monitoring state. SLA impact: short window of elevated error rates for Kestrel during shift; account team to quantify.

elaine_account: Customer call scheduled in 90 minutes to debrief. I'll attach timeline and mitigation steps.

raj_sales: Thanks team. Good playbook execution. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INC-2026-2347 updated to status=monitoring, severity=major. Postmortem placeholder: INC-2026-2347-PM.
